contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Inner Screen Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Inner screen recovery

actions.description: It will let you control the phone

steps: If you can no longer use the touchscreen, access data, such as pictures or messages, using a USB mouse.
Connect the adapter to your phone.
Connect the mouse's USB to the adapter.
Connect a keyboard the same way, so you are able to easily enter your PIN or Password.

actions.description: It will let you save data

steps: If your phone's screen is damaged and you can no longer see anything on it, back up your data by connecting it to your TV or monitor.

actions.description: It will let you view the screen

steps: Use a device like a DeX station or multi-port adapter to connect a mouse and keyboard in addition to HDMI.
Connect the adapter to your phone.
Connect the HDMI cable to the adapter.
Connect the other end of the HDMI cable to the HDMI port on the TV or monitor.
Power on your TV or monitor.
Select the input that your phone is connected to.
Mimic movements on your phone to back up your data with Data Transfer or other methods.
Visit a TechCorp walk-in service center, or schedule a repair service online.
